text:
Maria G.: Handoff — I'm on until 09:00 UTC. Quick status: pool-alpha at ~82% util, 3 high-latency tails reported by traces, small customer spike from corp-analytics. Burst credits at 18% for pool-alpha, pool-beta healthy. Leaving a sticky note: watch for sustained >90% for 3m, we should failover to pool-beta.

Kevin L.: Thanks — do we have an autoscale window set? last time we saw a spike autoscaler lagged ~90s.

Maria G.: Autoscale policy is conservative: min=10, max=60, scale cooldown=120s. I bumped short-term burst limit to allow 2 additional nodes but credits are still the limiter.

Sahil R.: FYI nightly-evals started ramp at 02:40 UTC, that was ~25% of the burst. I disabled the noncritical evals yesterday but looks like some customers triggered heavy reranks.

Maria G.: Command I ran just now: `rwcctl pool status --name=pool-alpha --format=json | jq '.utilization, .burst_credits'` output: `82, 18`. Also saw a 502 spike in LB logs around 02:58.

oncall-bot: [alert] burst_credit_threshold: pool-alpha below 20% (18%). No action automated; please review routing rules.

Kevin L.: Ok, plan: I'll watch for 90% sustained for 3m. If hit, I'll flip the routing weight to pool-beta (20% -> 50%) and open a canary for low-criticality tenants. @Sahil can you confirm no scheduled jobs will start in the next hour?

Sahil R.: Confirmed — no new scheduled batches until 06:00 UTC. I can also temporarily throttle corp-analytics to slow their traffic if we need to.

Jules T.: Quick ask — any lead on the tail latencies? If it's KV cache misses we might benefit from warming. :eyes:

Maria G.: Traces show most tails are KV-cache misses for long context requests. I'm pre-warming top-10 corp-analytics prefixes now. If you need to run a targeted warm, use: `rwcctl cache prewarm --pool=pool-alpha --prefix-file=/tmp/top10.txt`

Kevin L.: Sounds good. I'll stay on the watch and ping if I change routing. If anyone needs me to flip weights, ping `@kevin` in the thread. :thumbsup:

Maria G.: Leaving audit note in PagerDuty before I drop: PD-annotate "preflight: pool-alpha 82% util, burst credits 18% — monitor for 90% sustained". Back at 09:00 UTC.

Sahil R.: Thanks — I'll take over if Kevin needs to step out. :ok_hand:

oncall-bot: [info] handoff-recorded: owner=Maria G., coverage_until=2026-03-17T09:00:00Z, pools=["pool-alpha","pool-beta"]

Jules T.: good handoff, thanks Maria. I'll keep an eye on dashboards and post any anomalies here.
